test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

1. Some cotton cloths are silk cloths.

2. All silk cloths are woolen cloths.

3. No woolen cloth is a nylon cloth.

4. Some nylon cloths are polyester.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cotton cloths are nylon cloth.

Il. No silk cloth is a nylon cloth.

II. Some cotton cloths are woolen cloth.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III will follow.
Only conclusions I and II will follow.
Only conclusions II and III will follow.
All 3 conclusion I, II and III, will follow.

solution:
**Given **Statements:

1. Some cotton cloths are silk cloths.

2. All silk cloths are woolen cloths.

3. No woolen cloth is a nylon cloth.

4. Some nylon cloths are polyester.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ad16da8f5f3973cbb70f3ccb1fe92c25e3eb05a070fad5551cd0e7970b480ea.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some cotton cloths are nylon cloth. - **False **(Because, there is no direct relation given between cotton cloths and nylon cloth)

Il. No silk cloth is a nylon cloth. - **True **(Because, All silk cloths are woolen cloths and No woolen cloth is a nylon cloth so, No silk cloth is a nylon cloth).

II. Some cotton cloths are woolen cloth. - **True **(Because, Some cotton cloths are silk cloths and All silk cloths are woolen cloths, so Some cotton cloths are woolen cloth).

So, Only conclusions II and III will follow.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusions II and III will follow.".**
